1.A Brighter weather with good traffic ambient on the axis from the Interchange to Conoil, Danco and Berger yard this time.

2.Eldorado to Lufuwape,
Catholic and Danliti turn (New-Makun Axis) is good and motorable this moment.

3.Christopher University to Youth camp, RCCG main gate and Carpark C: good movement.

4.Mowe junction to Lotto, Olowotedo, Nasfat turn and Aseese: good movement on the stretch.

5.Oremeji to Ara Hall & Ibafo market and Mountain Top university (MTU): good to traverse.

6.MFM to Magboro:is equally experiencing good movement.

 *Section: LAG-IBD (Outbound Lagos):*

1.The return journey from Lagos to Magboro, MFM, Ibafo and Ara hall is experiencing good movement.

2.Aseese to Nasfat, Deeperlife and Lotto: good movement.

3.Mowe to Car park C RCCG Main gate, Youth camp good movement ,
 Christopher University: good movement.

4.Danliti to New Makun, Lenuwa, Eldorado is good. 

5.Danco to NNPC and Sagamu interchange: better movement.

Virtually, all the landmarks within the corridor are in good shape this time
